the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to integral base using functoriality of effectivity and the support behaviour under families of morphisms, then reduce further along a discrete valuation ring realizing the specialization from the generic point to any given point using the Properties lemma, and in the valuation ring case write the generic fibre as a positive combination of integral cycles, compute the closed fibre as the positive combination of the fibres of their closures which are equidimensional of the right dimension by the Varieties dimension lemma, so the support of the closed fibre is the fibre of the closure of the generic support, giving that the whole support is the closure of the generic support and hence closed (source lines 1945-1977)
